scope_summary: One existing project or one bootstrap project plus declared organization/folder and billing account; verifies the IAM API prerequisite and creates a prefixed deployment service account, custom role binding, and one user-managed key.

permission_groups.scope: Generated twin2mc-* service account in the selected project
Selected project custom role and project IAM policy
Only when mode=organization: declared organization/folder and billing account

credential_cleanup: Delete only the submitted service-account key after proving its service-account owner.
Remove the exact project binding before deleting the gate-owned service account and custom role.
Treat a gate-owned custom role with deleted=true as successfully deactivated during Google's seven-day soft-delete window; do not reuse its run ID.
Never delete or alter an existing_user_owned service-account key.
Return manual_revocation_required when key creation policy or delete authority prevents safe cleanup.
limitations: The IAM API must already be enabled; the identity-only gate may read its state but must not enable it or any workload API.
Organization policy can forbid user-managed service-account key creation; the bootstrap must fail closed and must not weaken that policy.
Organization mode needs separate organization/folder, billing, and bootstrap-project authority; a project Owner role is insufficient.
GCP custom-role deletion is reversible for seven days and permanent deletion can take up to 30 additional days.
The permission names and scope bindings require a separately approved query-testable-permissions and live validation.
